faults.description: Wren finds a brass key tagged "Box 14" hidden in the ledger's back cover and vows to find what it opens. It is mentioned once more and never resolved.
Jonah Marsh, the deckhand, says Elias was not alone the night he died and promises to tell Wren everything on Friday at six. He never appears or is mentioned again, and the meeting never happens.
Elias drowned in March (scenes 1, 2, 9, 10), but scene 8 calls it "the August night he drowned".
